title:
Gate-tunable chiral spin mode in WSe
                    <sub>2</sub>
                    /WS
                    <sub>2</sub>
                    moiré superlattices
title_zh: 可门控的手性自旋模式在WSe₂/WS₂ Moiré 超晶格中
abstract: The interplay between many-body and spin-orbit coupling (SOC) effects can lead to previously unobserved phenomena in solids. Chiral spin modes (CSMs) are collective spin excitations that arise from such interplay and connect states with opposite chirality. Here, we report a gate-tunable CSM that occurs between conduction SOC-split minibands in near-0°-twisted WSe 2 /WS 2 bilayers. This mode manifests as a sharp resonance with giant Raman efficiency in the pseudovector-symmetry channel of the Raman spectra. By varying the filling, the CSM transitions from a chiral spin exciton to an excitonic polaron. The spin-flip nature is directly confirmed by the Zeeman effect, and the filling dependence indicates a charge-transfer insulator at unity filling. Our results demonstrate that transition metal–dichalcogenide moiré superlattices are a fertile platform for exploring exotic low-lying collective excitations.
abstract_zh: 多体效应与自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）效应的相互作用可在固体中产生此前未观察到的现象。手性自旋模式（CSM）是由此相互作用产生的集体自旋激发，连接具有相反手性的态。本文报道了一种可门控的CSM，它出现在近0°扭转的WSe₂/WS₂双层中导电SOC分裂的子带之间。该模式在拉曼光谱的伪矢量对称通道中表现为尖锐共振，并具有巨大的拉曼效率。通过调节填充，CSM从手性自旋激子转变为激子极化子。自旋翻转特性通过Zeeman效应得到直接确认，填充依赖性表明在单位填充时存在电荷转移绝缘体。我们的结果表明，过渡金属二硫属化物的Moiré 超晶格是探索奇异低能集体激发的肥沃平台。
